title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our legal services

general.question: What are Legatoo's legal services?
general.answer: Legatoo is an intelligent legal platform that provides comprehensive services including contract analysis, legal document generation, legal consultations, and compliance management. We use artificial intelligence to deliver accurate and efficient legal solutions.

general.question: Are your services available throughout Saudi Arabia?
general.answer: Yes, our services are available throughout Saudi Arabia. We operate in accordance with Saudi laws and regulations and provide services tailored to the local legal environment.

general.question: How can I get started with Legatoo?
general.answer: You can easily get started by creating a free account or trying our 14-day free trial. After registration, you'll get immediate access to all basic features and can upgrade your account at any time.

general.question: Do I need prior legal knowledge to use the platform?
general.answer: No, Legatoo is designed to be easy to use even for people without a legal background. Our interface is simple and clear, and we provide detailed guidance for each step.

pricing.question: What subscription plans are available?
pricing.answer: We offer three main plans: Free Trial (14 days), Monthly Subscription (99 SAR), and Annual Subscription (999 SAR with 20% discount). Each plan offers different features to suit your needs.

pricing.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
pricing.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through the dashboard. The subscription will not auto-renew, and you'll retain access to your services until the end of the current billing period.

pricing.question: Do you offer money-back guarantee?
pricing.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with our services, you can request a full refund within the first 30 days of your subscription.

pricing.question: Are there any hidden fees?
pricing.answer: No, all prices are clear and transparent. There are no hidden fees. The advertised price includes all features mentioned in the plan.

technical.question: How does AI work in contract analysis?
technical.answer: We use advanced artificial intelligence technologies to analyze contracts and identify legal risks, important clauses, and contradictions. The system continuously learns from a vast database of legal contracts.

technical.question: Is my data secure and protected?
technical.answer: Yes, we use the highest security standards to protect your data. All data is encrypted using advanced encryption technologies, and we comply with international security standards like ISO 27001.

technical.question: Can I access the platform from any device?
technical.answer: Yes, Legatoo is available on all devices - computer, tablet, and smartphone. You can access your account from anywhere and at any time.

technical.question: What are the system requirements for use?
technical.answer: Legatoo works on all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). You don't need to install any additional software, just an internet connection.

legal.question: Does Legatoo replace a lawyer?
legal.answer: Legatoo is a legal assistance tool and not a replacement for a lawyer. We provide analyses and recommendations, but important legal decisions should be made in consultation with a qualified attorney.

legal.question: Are the generated documents legal and recognized?
legal.answer: Yes, all documents generated by Legatoo are compliant with Saudi laws and legally recognized. We continuously update our templates to ensure compliance with current laws.

legal.question: How can I ensure the accuracy of legal analyses?
legal.answer: We use a team of qualified lawyers to continuously review and update our algorithms. Additionally, we provide clear recommendations on when to consult a specialized attorney.

legal.question: Can I use Legatoo for criminal cases?
legal.answer: Legatoo is designed for civil and commercial cases. For criminal cases, we strongly recommend consulting an attorney specialized in criminal law.
